about: D-SINK-95 and D-SINK-96 (2026-11-11): where both free-text redactors read a URL and a credential token, one fixture for the two mirrors (CLAUDE.md: a rule in two languages gets one shared fixture), run by tests/test_url_marks.py (bin/helper's next_url, redact_urls, player_title_text, fold_space) and tests/Model.test.js (Model.urlAt, Model.redactUrls, Model.sinkText). `slashAlike` is the list both mirrors' SLASH_ALIKE constant must equal (Model.SLASH_ALIKE_CODES, SLASH_ALIKE_CHARS). The classes, recomputed by both suites from this file and url-whitespace.json over every code unit (node) and every code point (python): CROSSABLE is everything outside U+0020..U+007E; FILLER is CROSSABLE but no slash look-alike; STAND_IN is FILLER above U+009F that is not a member of url-whitespace.json's `codePoints` union (`standInExcludes`). Since the review of cbd6679 (2026-11-12): a WIDE code point is one above U+009F (a surrogate pair one), and each stretch the reading crosses holds at most one -- a FILLER stretch of a mark's P between its colons, the FILLER between its slashes, each CROSSABLE run the scheme walk crosses; an empty run is a URL in both mirrors; the helper prints a scheme only from NAMED_SCHEMES; a credential is a run of characters other than U+0020 across its URLs, holding an ASCII `:` outside every URL with an ASCII `@` after it and at most one COUNTED code point (above U+009F, no slash look-alike) outside the URLs between them, withheld from the run's start or after the last counted code point before the `:` when there are two or more; and a non-numeric port behind a userinfo is withheld at a redactor's print. `vectors`: `text`, the model's output `js` (Model.redactUrls and sinkText) and the helper's `py` (redact_urls); `jsDeleting` and `pyDeleting` where the sinks that delete control characters first (Model.notifyReasonText, which Model.notifyArgv composes the body with, and player_title_text) read otherwise; `pyFold` where fold_space then redact_urls reads otherwise. `fuzz`: every BMP code point but the surrogates and `qzQZ`, inserted at each listed position of each url, wrapped as `wrap` says; `leaks` is the exact set of code points whose output still holds a `q` or a `z`, per sink (`plain`: the redactors; `deleting`: after the controls are deleted; `fold`: fold_space then redact_urls, the helper's only). Measured on 2026-11-11 against 0.18.0's 1,142,679 plain, and again on 2026-11-12 after the review of cbd6679 (567 plain at cbd6679: the five delimiters TAB..CR inside the username at positions 10 and 13 no longer leak, the token being read across the URL the delimiter ends).
credentialsAreFake: Every credential here is the fake qqqqqq / zzzzzz on cdn.test, under the reserved .test TLD.
